name: Tilework
summary: A resumable download drawn as a mosaic: each chunk flips into a coloured tile, and pauses keep every byte
about: Tilework shows a big download as 50 chunks laid out like a mosaic wall. Three chunks fill at a time and flip over into coloured tiles that slowly build a diamond pattern, while speed, MB and time left update below. Pause, or drop the Wi-Fi on purpose: the chunks in flight turn red but keep their bytes, it retries by itself and carries on from the last byte, and the finished wall shimmers with a gloss sweep.
how: Press Download; three chunks fill at once and flip into tiles as they finish.
Press Pause and Resume as often as you like; nothing already fetched is lost.
Press Drop Wi-Fi to cut the connection: red chunks keep their bytes and it reconnects after a 3 second countdown (or press Reconnect).
At 100% the wall ripples and shines and a Saved ribbon pops up; press Again to replay.
